dataset.scope: U2OS cells with endogenous FBL-sfGFP and NPM1-mTagRFP knock-ins; Hoechst nuclear stain. Olympus IX83 widefield, 40x/1.4 oil, 0.1625 um/px, single plane, uint16 OME-TIFF.
dataset.modifications: Centre 1536 x 1536 crop of each 2304 x 2304 plane; channels Hoechst (OME c3, filter DAPI) and NPM1-mTagRFP (OME c1, filter TRITC) only; pixel values unchanged; re-saved as uncompressed single-plane TIFF.
caveats: All replicates (Rep1-Rep3) were acquired on the same date (2021-12-01). The source does not state whether Rep1-Rep3 are independent experiments; they are treated as replicate units for demonstration only.

Each replicate contains both conditions; the demo pairs conditions by replicate (paired t-test over three pairs, one field per condition and replicate). With three pairs the test has very low power; p-values are illustrations of the workflow, not findings.

Nucleoli are defined from NPM1 with the workspace's nucleolar-marker definition (default parameters). Under ActD, NPM1 partly relocates to the nucleoplasm, so marker-defined nucleoli reflect NPM1 distribution, not nucleolar structure alone.
Hoechst saturates (value 65535) in a small fraction of pixels in some fields; counts are listed in manifest.json (selection.results[].saturated_pixels).
Demonstration numbers from public images; they do not establish scientific validity for any laboratory's images.
デモのAI解析案は、例文に対して用意した設定案を返します（外部AIは呼び出しません）。

derivation_rule: Pre-registered (coordinator, before any measurement): crop the centred 1536 x 1536 region of each 2304 x 2304 plane (no other processing, uint16 values unchanged). For each condition (Untreated, ActD1) x replicate (Rep1-Rep3), take fields in acquisition order and keep the first whose number of whole nuclei inside the crop, counted by StarDist on the Hoechst channel only with the default nuclear recipe (region-2d 1.7.0, nuclear-size/1.0.0, probability 0.5, NMS 0.3; nuclei touching the crop border excluded), is 10-20. Amendment recorded before any NPM1 measurement or statistics: the original rule kept the first 3 qualifying fields per cell; it was reduced to the first 1 qualifying field to keep the published bundle size near 40 MB (each 1536 x 1536 field costs about 7.5 MB losslessly). NPM1 is never read during selection.

scenario_notes.unit_definition: 反復（Rep1–Rep3）内の各処理条件（同日撮影。反復の独立性は出典に記載なし）
scenario_notes.pairing_basis: 同じ反復（Rep）で撮影したUntreated と ActD 1 µM
scenario_notes.design_note: Each replicate (Rep1-Rep3) contains both conditions, so conditions are paired by replicate: experimental unit = one condition within one replicate, pair = replicate. The comparison is a paired t-test over three replicate pairs; the source does not state that replicates are independent experiments.
scenario_notes.statistics_amendment: The planned nucleolar/nucleoplasm analyses could not be saved: the workspace refuses cohorts of compartment revisions until every parent nucleus has a resolved candidate state (assert_complete_compartments), and the NPM1 Cellpose-SAM detection left unresolved parents (no_candidate / indeterminate / review_required) in every field, including all parents of one ActD field. Excluding those nuclei would select cells by the outcome, so the saved statistics use the nuclear region set instead. The change was made because of this software gate, before any statistical result was computed; the nucleolar masks and their per-parent states remain visible in the image view.
scenario_notes.grid_notes: Nuclei: full 3 x 3 grid of StarDist probability (0.4/0.5/0.6) and NMS (0.2/0.3/0.4) at the automatic detection scale on all fields. The default marker definition is computed in the browser for any nuclear result. NCL-positive alternatives (Cellpose-SAM 4.3.0 with default settings, one CPU inference 1.5-18 min per field; Fiji NCL threshold with default settings) are recorded on all fields for the default nuclear result only; after changing the nuclear setting they report showcase_detection_not_recorded. Cellpose-SAM cell ROI is not recorded: the dataset has no cell-boundary or cytoplasmic channel.
